title: Fireproof Bundles & Shulkers
description: Allows for bundles and shulker boxes to be upgraded with netherite upgrades templates to keep items even if they fall in lava.
body:
# 🔥 Fireproof Bundles & Shulkers
Fire proof your items using netherite upgrade templates and netherite ingots in a smithing table upgrading any shulker box or bundle to make them immune to lava and fire, like netherite. Allowing for you to keep your items safely in your shulker box or bundle even through fire and lava.


- Fireproof items have orange text under them that says "Fireproof".
  
- Fireproof items retain their Fireproof quality when placed, mined, or dyed.
  
- Fireproof items work in a similar way as how netherite equipment does regarding fireproofing.

## Updates
- V. 1.1 Makes the recipe show when obtaining netherite.
  
- V. 1.1 Makes the datapack description field accurate in minecraft.
